summary: Current main still routes direct dist/index.js root-version calls into runCli before the existing fast path, creating TTY startup progress before synchronous version exit. actions.reason: A root-only --version/-V/-v invocation should use the existing fast path before startup progress; container-targeted requests must continue through runCli.
Use the existing fast path at the legacy entry boundary; do not alter progress behavior globally.
